source_refs.section: Steps to turn Easy Mode on or off in Settings
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Toggle the switch to turn Easy Mode on or off.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Samsung Galaxy: Open the Settings app on your Samsung Galaxy device. Navigate to Display. Select Easy Mode. Toggle the switch to turn Easy Mode on or off. Easy Mode simplifies your Samsung Galaxy device interface by enlarging icons, fonts, and spacing for easier navigation.
